counting_rule: Only actual returns with applied manual approvals satisfying current hair, collar and raw-fullsize art contracts. Prepared, pending, rejected and refused sources do not count. This is art coverage, not live-game acceptance or release readiness.
remote_scope: Only the 2973 exact PNGs and bytes in the pinned receipt have been remotely read back. Later local PNGs, approvals, reports and frozen requests await their next production checkpoint.
forecast_assumptions: 30-45 net actually visually qualified distinct sources per continuous hour. Refusals, cooldown/exhausted sources, HIGH gate, 748 unresolved baseline references, two non-person scope deferrals, full-export storage admission and live-game acceptance can delay the tail. These are conditional art estimates, not release dates.
execution: The sole built-in image lane continues; review decisions are staged and applied by its executor between imports. Repairs and milestone reporting do not hold unrelated original requests.
